name: Store use cases and proposals
description: The workspace keeps one file per entity: each use case in .lastro/usecases/<id>-<slug>.json (id, slug, name, description, history), each proof of a use case in .lastro/proof/<proof-id>-<slug>.json and each proposal in .lastro/proposals/<id>-<slug>.json, with its receipt next to it. Use cases are numbered UC-001, UC-002... and proposals P-001, P-002... with the next free number, never reused even after a removal; intents and proofs are numbered inside their proposal (P-007.I-03, P-007.PF-05) and keep that id when a proof moves to its use case; proofs derived straight from a use case are numbered inside it (UC-003.PF-01). Slugs are kebab-case and stable: a rename changes only the name. intents.json, spec.json and proof.json are no longer written. A use case file that still carries a proofs list is read as before, and its proofs move to .lastro/proof/ the next time the workspace writes that use case.
